nwc.config.title: Nvidium World Cache — Settings
nwc.config.sodium.all.help: Opens the full screen, including the cache name. Apply changes on this page before opening.
nwc.config.reopen: Save applies settings during gameplay. Reducing distance or memory releases distant terrain gradually. World Gen generates real terrain in local worlds and increases save size.
nwc.config.adaptiveGeneration.help: Requests faster while the server keeps up, slower when it falls behind. Enabled by default. Memory and pending request limits still apply.
nwc.config.mode.help: Exploration only stores received terrain. World Gen also generates an area when joining local worlds without visiting it. Does not generate on remote servers.
nwc.config.generateWhilePaused: Generate while paused or in background
nwc.config.generateWhilePaused.help: Keeps your local server running while World Gen is active, even in the pause menu or another window. Time passes, mobs move and machines keep running. Normal pause returns when generation ends or is paused.
nwc.config.followPlayer.help: Recenters generation after travel or teleportation. Previously saved terrain stays cached; only one task remains active. Disable to generate only near the entry or manual starting point.
nwc.config.genRadius.help: Area generated around the player. 16 chunks = 1,089 positions; 128 = 66,049. Follow the player moves this area after travel or teleportation. Larger values use more time and disk space.
nwc.config.genInterval.help: Delay between requests in manual mode or under load. Automatic mode uses 1 tick while the server keeps up. Lower is faster; higher reduces load.
nwc.config.genParallel.help: Allows 1 to 16 concurrent generation requests. Start with 4; increase when RAM and CPU have room, reduce if the game stutters. Capture and storage have separate limits.
nwc.config.diskLimit.help: Sums this instance's world and dimension caches. Pauses writes and generation when reached. Never deletes data. 8192 MiB = 8 GiB. Excludes normal saves.
nwc.config.diskReserve.help: Pauses writes and generation when space is low. Start with 4096 MiB (4 GiB). Saves and other applications can still consume space; not an OS quota.
nwc.config.enabled.help: Stores terrain received by the game and displays it at a distance. Leave enabled to use the mod.
nwc.config.radius.help: How far to look for saved terrain around you. Each chunk is 16 blocks wide. Increase to see farther if enough memory and saved chunks are available.
nwc.config.chunks: Limit of chunks loaded from cache
nwc.config.chunks.help: How many saved chunks can stay loaded at once. Increase if terrain is missing despite a high distance; higher values use more RAM.
nwc.config.restoreBatch.help: How many cached chunks can be installed per update (normally 20 per second). Increase for faster loading; decrease if the game stutters. The work time also limits loading.
nwc.config.meshBatch.help: How many 16×16×16 block parts can be prepared for display per frame. Increase to make terrain appear sooner; decrease if FPS drops. Start with 4.
nwc.config.memory.help: Approximate RAM limit for keeping saved terrain loaded. Increase to fit more terrain; decrease to save memory. 1024 MiB = 1 GiB.
nwc.config.debounce.help: Wait after the last change before saving the chunk. 20 ticks ≈ 1 second. Increase to write less often; decrease to save changes sooner.
nwc.config.age.help: Saves even if the chunk keeps changing. 200 ticks ≈ 10 seconds. Decrease to save more often; keep at least as high as the delay after changes.
nwc.config.age.error: Maximum delay must be at least the delay after changes.
nwc.config.budget.help: Time the mod tries to spend copying and installing chunks per update. Start with 2 ms. Increase for faster loading; decrease if the game stutters. A single chunk can exceed this time.
nwc.config.budget.error: Enter a finite number between 0.1 and 10.
nwc.config.namespace.help: Usually leave default. Change the name if a server resets its map to start a separate cache. Restore the old name to access the previous cache.
nwc.config.namespace.error: Use 1 to 128 characters, with at least one non-whitespace character.
nwc.config.preset.help: Stable uses less CPU; Fast loads more quickly; Ultra uses more CPU. On save, adjusts cache loading and World Gen pace. Choose Keep manual settings to preserve your changes.
nwc.config.speed.help: Speeds up cached terrain restoration and shortens the wait between World Gen requests. Higher values use more CPU; reduce if gameplay stutters. Does not change distance or memory.
nwc.config.group.help: Groups neighboring chunks when reading: 2×2 = 4, 4×4 = 16, 8×8 = 64 and 16×16 = 256. Start with 4×4. Large groups load in stages within time and memory limits.
